glossary.holds: this record is self-consistent and recomputes to itself; not a claim that the test it describes passed
glossary.pass: the test the record describes passed (quantum volume); can be false beside holds true
glossary.factored: the run found p and q with p * q = n; `by` says whether by period or by gcd
glossary.measured: a held state was read for these shots; shots from nothing are never listed
glossary.sampled: false everywhere: outcomes enumerate the support, they are not drawn; the unit holds no entropy
glossary.read: how each argument was taken (digits, number, numeric, absent, default) and whether exactly
glossary.beyond: the order of the base exists and does not divide four, so a two-qubit register cannot resolve it
glossary.device: exact-amplitudes when every amplitude held is an exact integer; unmeasured otherwise
glossary.QPU: quantum processing unit — this unit. The VideoCore QPU (Quad Processing Unit, Broadcom; QPULib by Matthew Naylor, MIT, 2016) is prior use of the acronym, a classical SIMD vector core, unrelated and credited
glossary.seat: reference, vector or device: the router computes on the reference (the exact integer state-vector computation) unless the runtime exposes a vector binding; the device seat is empty, no device is dispatched, and a device that disagrees with the reference is a driver bug, never a physics claim
